messages:
sara: Heads up — the API quickstart page (/docs/api/quickstart) still has a curl example using POST /v1/generate and model: redwood-alpha. That model is retired and the endpoint should be /v2/completions. Also the 'architecture diagram' link on that page 404s (assets.redwood.ai/.../inference-arch.svg). Can someone from docs triage? cc @mike

mike: Can you paste the exact URL and the snippet here? If it's a tiny change I can open a PR and patch it today.

sara: URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/quickstart
Current snippet on the page:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","prompt":"Hello"}'
```

kevin: We moved to v2 and the canonical model name for public examples is now `rwd-1-large`. Also use `Content-Type: application/json` header and `input` key, e.g.
```json
{ "model": "rwd-1-large", "input": "Hello" }
```
The assets repo has the current diagram at https://assets.redwood.ai/docs/inference/arch.svg (looks like the docs page points to an old path).

mike: Thanks — I'll update the curl block to v2 + rwd-1-large and fix the link target. @maria are you able to review? I'll add a note about the deprecation behavior too. I'll open a PR.

maria: I can review. If the page doesn't have an `owner:` frontmatter we'll add `owner: @maria` when we patch. I'll also add a one-line changelog entry in the docs release notes. ETA ~2h.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4213 by mike-docs — patch updates snippet, replaces diagram path, and adds deprecation note. CI started.

sara: :thumbsup: One more ask — please add an explicit migration example for the v1 -> v2 body so users who have saved snippets know what to change. Avoid silent failures.

mike: Will do. Plan: update example curl, add migration snippet, add NOTE: "v1 endpoints deprecated 2026-03-17 — requests will 301 to /v2 for 90 days; update saved scripts."

maria: LGTM, will merge once tests pass.

sara: Thanks y'all!
